info.title: Galilei Donna
info.synopsis: 2061, il riscaldamento globale è ormai un lontano e superato problema, ora l’umanità ne deve affrontare uno ben più grave: l’avvicinarsi di una nuova era glaciale, che con il suo gelido candore sta per ricoprire tutto il pianeta. Tre discendenti di Galileo Galilei - Hozuki, Hazuki e Kazuki Ferrari - conducono una tranquilla esistenza in Toscana, ma un giorno vengono improvvisamente attaccate da una misteriosa organizzazione in cerca del “Tesoro di Galileo”. Contro le ignare sorelle viene addirittura spiccato un mandato di cattura internazionale, così le tre, per sfuggire, dovranno mettere insieme le loro forze, compito tutt’altro che facile considerata la loro totale incompatibilità caratteriale.

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis: Hozuki Ferrari is pursued by unknown individuals at the same time that her two older sisters, Kazuki and Hazuki, are attacked by strangers. Although they have no idea why they would become targets, the police decide the situation demands that they guard the Ferrari family home. There, the Ferraris encounter unexpected guests...

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis: Although Hozuki has successfully driven off Cicinho and his crew, the Ferrari family's relief is short-lived as the police suddenly draw their weapons and escort the family off to a holding cell. The only one to avoid detention, Hozuki runs in to a Galileo fanatic named Anna. After Anna tells her the truth behind the chain of events, Hozuki decides she needs to save her family.

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.synopsis: Now international fugitives, the three sisters are forced to travel on the Galileo with Anna. Jealous of Hozuki's talents, Kazuki has a difficult time adjusting to their time together. As tension builds aboard the Galileo, an Aza Iron piloted by Roberto suddenly appears.

episodes.title: Episodio 4
episodes.synopsis: With neither food nor clothing aboard the Galileo, Kazuki is furious, and everyone's mood has hit a new low. They decide to go to Germany in order to break the impasse and find Galileo's sketches of the moon. Although they go shopping in disguise, the Black Ganymede finds them...

episodes.title: Episodio 5

episodes.title: Episodio 6
episodes.synopsis: Hozuki and Kazuki sneak into a hospital with Anna to get medicine for Hazuki. There, they run into Cicinho and Roberto, who had shot each other down from the sky. As the blizzard rages outside, a blackout causes rising tensions between the people inside the hospital.

episodes.title: Episodio 7
episodes.synopsis: Galileo Tesoro is revealed to be a tremendous energy source contained within Hozuki's hourglass. Roberto captures the Galileo in order to take the Tesoro from the sisters. The sisters put up a valiant fight, but they are no match for Roberto...

episodes.synopsis: The three sisters continue their search for Galileo's sketches. Their next stop is Japan, where they visit their grandfather living in Kyoto. They gain a few moments' respite as Hozuki tries to finish a device begun long ago by Geshio.
